description: Playwright-based pre-launch SEO validation crawl for WordPress sites. Discovers pages via sitemap, renders in a real browser, extracts and validates SEO signals (H1, canonical, OG, alt text, structured data, links), checks mobile rendering with device emulation, and produces an observational findings report.

required.name: site-config.json
required.description: Target site URL, optional auth credentials reference, crawl scope rules (include/exclude patterns), and page-type classification hints

optional.name: check-config.json
optional.description: Which checks to run, pass/fail thresholds, mobile devices to emulate. Defaults to all checks with standard thresholds.

optional.name: known-issues.json
optional.description: Known issues to suppress from the findings report (e.g., expected missing alt text on decorative images)

directories.description: Page inventory, raw HTML snapshots, and extracted SEO signals per page
Per-page JSON files with extracted SEO signals
Aggregate findings report and JSON summary

_quarantine_note: Harness assets not yet created. Framework has prompts and guardrails only. Register in system.yaml and create .claude/ assets before promotion.

prompt::01_INTAKE_AND_SITE_DISCOVERY.transfer_notes: Site URL inventory build; transferable to any whole-site audit (QA, CRO, accessibility) by swapping the signal list.

prompt::02_CRAWL_AND_EXTRACT.transfer_notes: curl+parse signal extraction over a URL inventory; signal schema is the tweak point.

prompt::03_VALIDATE_CHECKS.transfer_notes: Deterministic check battery over extracted signals incl. redirect-matrix evidence; check definitions are data, the loop is generic.

prompt::04_MOBILE_AND_PERFORMANCE.transfer_notes: Browser-based rendering/perf pass; transfers to any responsive QA with viewport list tweak.

prompt::05_FINDINGS_REPORT.transfer_notes: Findings->severity->evidence report shape; transferable as-is to any audit domain.

prompt::06_DEV_HANDOFF.transfer_notes: Converts findings to actionable dev tasks; pairs with any findings report.
